'''Jacques Brodeur''' is a Canadian biologist, currently a [[Canada Research Chair]] in Biocontrol at [[Université de Montréal]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.irbv.umontreal.ca/chercheurs/jacques-brodeur?lang=en|title=Jacques Brodeur {{!}} Institut de recherche en biologie végétale|last=|first=|date=|website=Université de Montréal|language=en-US|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.chairs-chaires.gc.ca/chairholders-titulaires/profile-eng.aspx?profileId=1671|title=Jacques Brodeur|last=|first=|date=2012-11-29|website=Canada Research Chairs|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://qcbs.ca/member/|title=Jacques Brodeur|last=|first=|date=|website=Quebec Centre for Biodiversity Science|language=en-US|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-05-04}}</ref>
